resume_text:
# Jane Doe
Backend engineer with 5 years of experience building distributed systems in Python and Go.

## Summary
Pragmatic backend engineer focused on reliability, developer tooling, and API design. Enjoys mentoring and writing clear documentation.

## Experience

### Senior Software Engineer, Northwind Systems (2022 - Present)
- Led migration of a monolithic order-processing service to a set of async Python microservices, cutting P99 latency by 40%.
- Designed the internal RBAC library adopted across 12 services.
- Mentored two junior engineers through onboarding and their first on-call rotations.

### Software Engineer, Brightloop Analytics (2019 - 2022)
- Built a streaming ETL pipeline (Kafka + Go) processing 2M events/day.
- Owned the public REST API, including versioning strategy and OpenAPI docs.
- Reduced CI pipeline runtime from 22 minutes to 7 minutes by parallelizing test suites.

## Skills
- Languages: Python, Go, TypeScript, SQL
- Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS (ECS, RDS, S3)
- Practices: TDD, code review, incident response, API design

## Education

### B.S. in Computer Science, University of Washington (2015 - 2019)
- Focus in distributed systems and databases.

## Projects
- pathreview-cli: a command-line tool for linting internal API contracts.
- ledger-sim: a toy double-entry ledger used for teaching transaction consistency.
